Tomato Powder Price and B2B Supply Overview

Tomato powder is a dry, concentrated form of tomato that soup, sauce, snack and seasoning manufacturers use in place of paste or puree. Tradenest Naturals manufactures spray dried tomato powder in India and supplies it to food processors, industrial blenders, private label brand owners, commercial kitchens and distributors. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, and the powder is made to give a full tomato taste, a steady red color and good storage stability. If you are comparing tomato powder pricing, our team can send a current tomato powder wholesale price, the product specification sheet and a sample. We work with both standard and customized supply programs, and we ship worldwide from India.

Product Description

Tomato Powder is a fine, low-moisture ingredient that brings tomato flavor, color, natural acidity and solids into dry and wet food formulations. It is a practical, shelf-stable alternative to fresh tomatoes, purees and pastes. It needs far less handling, allows precise dosing and keeps supply steady through the year, whatever the tomato season. Our powder is spray dried, which gives a free-flowing product that disperses well in water and in dry blends. Any carrier system and the packaging are agreed with you in advance and recorded on the product specification sheet. The standard grade is 80 mesh tomato powder. This particle size blends evenly in seasoning mixes and runs well on filling lines. Unless a custom formulation states otherwise, the standard product contains no artificial colors or added preservatives. Any carrier, anti-caking agent or processing aid is disclosed and approved by the buyer before production, so your ingredient declaration stays accurate.

Manufacturing and Processing

Our process covers raw material selection, sorting, washing, pulping, spray drying, sieving, inspection and food-grade packing. Tomatoes are checked for ripeness, flavor, color and suitability for processing before they are accepted. Selected tomatoes are cleaned and prepared, then concentrated and spray dried. Spray drying removes water quickly and produces a free-flowing powder that disperses easily. Because the drying step is short, the powder keeps more of the bright, cooked-tomato character that buyers look for in sauces and seasonings. After drying, the powder passes through calibrated sieves to reach 80 mesh. We keep batch records and control the process to reduce lot-to-lot variation in color and taste. Before dispatch, each batch is checked against the agreed specification, packaging requirements and destination labeling rules. Tradenest Naturals also offers custom formulations, private label retail packing, bulk industrial packs and OEM manufacturing for buyers who need a particular flavor strength, color level or carrier.

Typical Technical Specifications

  • Form: Free-flowing, uniform powder
  • Processing: Spray dried
  • Particle Size: 80 mesh
  • Moisture Content: ≤ 6%
  • Shelf Life: 12 months in sealed packaging
  • Color Profile: Natural red to orange-red, varying slightly with the season's raw material
  • Flavor and Aroma: Characteristic ripe tomato taste with mild natural acidity
These values appear on the product specification sheet shared with every quotation. If your market requires specific analytical results, allergen statements or nutritional data, please send your destination requirements before quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This keeps the documentation package clear and based only on what has actually been checked for your order.

Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our quality approach rests on careful raw material selection, moisture control, batch traceability, written operating procedures, sieving and packaging checks before each lot is released. For each shipment we provide export documentation support, including the commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin. Ingredient declarations and allergen statements can be prepared on request. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Clients can send us their own technical specifications, retail guidelines or import checklists at any stage of the inquiry. Our team compares them with what we can produce and suggests any changes needed to processing, labeling or packaging. Where a buyer wants independent results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This helps your shipment clear customs smoothly and reach the shelf without surprises.

Applications in Food Manufacturing

Food manufacturers use tomato powder because it is easy to handle, simple to dose and compact to store. It can be added straight into dry mixes or reconstituted with water and other ingredients to build a tomato base. Common applications include:
  • Dry soup, sauce, gravy and instant meal premixes
  • Seasoning blends for snacks, extruded snacks, popcorn, noodles, pasta and French fries
  • Bakery products, crackers and snack crusts that need tomato flavor or natural color
  • Ready-to-cook (RTC) and ready-to-eat (RTE) convenience foods
  • Pizza sauces, pasta bases, ketchup-style seasonings and spice rubs
  • Savory dry drink mixes and other culinary formulations
We recommend running application trials before full-scale production. The right usage rate depends on the tomato intensity you want, recipe moisture, salt and acid balance, and processing temperatures. Our team can help with reconstitution trials, flavor matching, blend uniformity and cost-in-use calculations. As a rough guide, buyers making seasonings often start with small additions and adjust upward, while soup and sauce makers use more powder to build body and color. Your own trials will show the right level for your recipe.

Buyer Value and Advantages

  • Much longer shelf life than fresh tomatoes when stored under recommended conditions
  • Lower transport weight, freight cost and warehouse space than liquid tomato paste or puree
  • Consistent dosing on automated dry blending lines and in portion-controlled production
  • Packaging formats and custom formulations matched to your production line
  • Less exposure to seasonal price swings and no prep work, which makes year-round planning easier
  • Supply for bulk wholesale volumes, private label retail lines and export programs

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard packs are available in 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg sizes. Export buyers can choose corrugated boxes, multi-wall paper bags or heavy-duty bulk liners. We also offer stand-up pouches, PET jars, custom printed retail packs and private label formats. Every master carton and inner liner carries the product name, batch number, production date, best-before date, net weight and storage instructions. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date in unopened packaging under recommended storage conditions. Store the product in a cool, dry and clean place, away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity and strong odors. Tomato powder picks up moisture easily, so reseal opened packs at once and use clean, dry scoops when handling it. In humid climates, buyers often choose smaller pack sizes so that each opened pack is used up quickly. Our team can suggest a pack size that suits your rate of use.

MOQ, Lead Times, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for tomato powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This lets new buyers trial the product in their own recipes before committing to larger volumes. Samples are available on request. Custom formulations, retail pouches and printed packaging need extra planning, and we confirm the details after reviewing your specification. Lead time depends on stock, raw material availability, order volume, packaging and destination documents, and we confirm it with each quotation. Standard items ship sooner than custom blends or private label programs. To request a sample or quotation, please share your target specification, estimated volume, preferred packaging, destination country, intended application and any regulatory requirements. Tradenest Naturals will reply with pricing, sample details and a dispatch plan. Tomato powder price depends on order volume, packaging, season and delivery terms, so a written quotation is the most reliable way to compare offers.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals is a B2B manufacturer, wholesale supplier, private label partner and exporter of dehydrated and spray dried food ingredients, based in Surat, India. Our work covers dehydration, spray dried powders, grinding, blending, sieving, custom formulation, bulk packing and OEM manufacturing. If you need a tomato powder supplier from India, a steady export partner or help developing an ingredient, we offer clear specifications, transparent communication, flexible packaging and fair commercial terms. Our export team handles the paperwork for each shipment and keeps you updated from order confirmation to dispatch.
